search_notes: Isolated Hermes Agent run using gpt-6-luna with xhigh reasoning and web tools.

Focused searches and source checks found support for Wilson and Babolat as tennis-racket customers and for Topkey producing tennis and badminton rackets, but no reliable evidence establishing Wilson as the largest customer or either brand as a badminton-racket customer.
The named customer evidence is a 2018 MoneyDJ report republished by LINE TODAY, not a current issuer filing; it does not give customer revenue shares or rankings.
The issuer's 2022 Q4 investor presentation supports the tennis/badminton product categories but does not map either named brand to badminton-racket production.
The official product-test page names Wilson and Babolat in racket-brand certifications, but does not disclose customer rank or racket-sport category by brand.
